Welcome.Title: Welcome to CodeWF.Avalonia
Welcome.Desc: Browse APIs by function, with one primary menu entry per control. Composite examples are in the final group; source is optional, with property and log feedback.

MarkdownFlow.Title: Writing Flow
MarkdownFlow.Desc: Open → edit → live preview → export / copy → task write-back: five steps chained into one Markdown workflow, each reusing the very same component pages.

DataFlow.Title: Data Flow
DataFlow.Desc: Import → columns → sort/filter → export: the full tabular-data path, with matching enhancement switches on the property panel.

DocsFlow.Title: Docs Flow
DocsFlow.Desc: Dock layout → document tabs → panel sync → status feedback: how the Dock workspace cooperates with the explorer, property and log panels.

MarkdownViewer.Title: MarkdownViewer
MarkdownViewer.Desc: Full rendering pipeline: 12 typography themes, incremental rendering, block virtualization and task write-back; switch themes from the property panel.

MarkdownLite.Title: Markdown Lite
MarkdownLite.Desc: The Lite package ships only the rendering pipeline and 12 themes; images degrade to alt text, formulas stay raw and code blocks render in a single color.

MarkdownEditor.Title: Markdown Editor
MarkdownEditor.Desc: MarkdownEditorView: AvaloniaEdit-based source editing with TextMate highlighting and ~40 editing actions; tune font size, line numbers and auto-pairing from the property panel.

MarkdownLiveEditor.Title: Live Editor
MarkdownLiveEditor.Desc: MarkdownLiveEditorView: single-column WYSIWYG block editing; documents are modeled as blocks and render as you type.

MarkdownExport.Title: Markdown Export
MarkdownExport.Desc: MarkdownDocumentExporter exports PNG / PDF / Word / HTML; MarkdownHtmlClipboard copies rich text for WeChat / Zhihu / Juejin.

DataGrid.Title: DataGrid Enhancement
DataGrid.Desc: DataGridEnhancement.UseDefaults enables three-state sorting, natural sorting and smart tooltips in one shot; the native grid below is the baseline.

PropertyGrid.Title: PropertyGrid
PropertyGrid.Desc: Four-level property tree: categorized/alphabetical views, search filtering, bold modifications, dynamic summaries and visibility; the right panel is this very control.

CodeWFWindow.Title: CodeWFWindow
CodeWFWindow.Desc: Borderless window: DWM rounded corners, custom title bar, button toggles and content extending into the title bar; open real windows with different configs below.

SearchListBox.Title: SearchListBox
SearchListBox.Desc: Searchable list: 400ms debounced filtering, multi-selection, count bar and double-tap events; live metrics show on the property panel.

Transfer.Title: Transfer
Transfer.Desc: Two-column shuttle: move items via buttons or double-tap, each side with its own search box; items move directly on the source collections.

Status.Title: Status Components
Status.Desc: StatusBadge / StatusCard: five semantic states (Debug/Info/Warn/Error/Fatal) with light/dark palettes driven by Kind pseudo-classes.

Guide.Title: Guide
Guide.Desc: Spotlight guidance: 13 placement modes, keyboard navigation, missing-target behavior and custom mask color; click Start Guide to try it.

AppGuide.Title: App Guide
AppGuide.Desc: Guides the whole showcase region by region (Ribbon / nav tree / documents / property panel / log panel); cross-control-tree targets are resolved in code.

WindowedStackPanel.Title: WindowedStackPanel
WindowedStackPanel.Desc: Windowed virtualizing stack panel: generate 5000 blocks and only viewport-adjacent blocks are realized; watch live metrics while scrolling.

ColumnDisplayEditor.Title: ColumnDisplayEditor
ColumnDisplayEditor.Desc: Column display editor: drag-handle reordering plus visibility checkboxes, moving directly on the source collection with live auditing.

MarkupExtension.Title: Markup Extensions
MarkupExtension.Desc: If / Switch markup extensions: conditional and multi-branch value selection in XAML, mixing bindings and constants.

Log.Title: Log
Log.Desc: LogView + Logger: live event feed, level filtering, copy / clear / open-log-folder context menu; the bottom panel hosts another instance.

Lang.Title: Lang
Lang.Desc: I18nManager: JSON backend folder scanning, embedded resource appending and instant culture switching for all I18n bindings.

Dock.Title: Dock Workspace
Dock.Desc: Dock.Avalonia layout engine + CodeWF DockSemiTheme: drag docking, floating and maximization; document content rendered by MarkdownViewer.

TrapezoidTab.Title: Trapezoid Tabs
TrapezoidTab.Desc: TrapezoidShapedTabControl / TabStrip themes: trapezoid paths adapt to first/middle/last tabs automatically; the showcase document tabs use this theme.

Welcome.FeaturesMarkdown: · Markdown: rendering (12 themes / virtualization / incremental), Lite, source editor, live editor, export and social copy
Welcome.FeaturesData: · Data: DataGrid enhancement (three-state / natural sorting / smart tooltips), PropertyGrid panel
